text:
Situation: Morphine sulfate injection has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2017-10-31 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 2.7 days of 2 mg/mL 1 mL cartridges and 5.4 days of 1 mg/mL 10 mL ampules. Corvale General holds 16.7 days of 2 mg/mL 1 mL and 16.4 days of 1 mg/mL 10 mL. Corvale Lakeside holds 14.7 days and 26.7 days of 2 mg/mL presentations. A rule-approved transfer of 51 units of 2 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East would leave the sender with 14 days and the receiver with 5 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2017-10-31. Fresenius Kabi inspections ended 2016-02-04, 2017-02-01, and 2017-03-30 were classified VAI, with letters dated 2016-08-03, 2017-05-02 (estimated), and 2017-11-08. An OAI inspection ended 2011-07-08 with a letter dated 2017-12-28. Hikma inspections ended 2019-09-10, 2023-11-03, and 2024-06-12 were classified VAI, with letters dated 2020-02-10, 2023-12-07, and 2024-12-16 — all after the 2017-10-31 posting.

Our position: We have sufficient aggregate inventory across sites to support internal redistribution. Alternate presentations from Hospira and Fresenius Kabi are listed as Current by FDA and have prior clinical approvals. Civica supply is not on the FDA shortage list but lacks plant transparency.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 51 units of morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval and DEA Form 222 or CSOS order (Schedule II).
2. Execute transfer of 47 units of morphine sulfate 1 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval and DEA Form 222 or CSOS order (Schedule II).
3. Procure morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL from Hospira, Inc. (NDC 00409189001) — requires pharmacist verification of dose and volume; approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-08-13.
4. Procure morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires pharmacist verification for NDC substitution; approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2025-10-09.
5. Evaluate Civica, Inc. supply for future orders — requires buyer action.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions without treating clinician and P&T committee review.
